_meta.description: Stage 3 (Credentialized) for the Anaplan Platform foundational journey. Three hands-on platform labs (model build, UX page build, integration) followed by the Anaplan Certified Solutions Associate (or equivalent) certification exam. Completion of Stage 3 unlocks Anaplan Platform certification — the prerequisite for every per-application Delivery and Pre-Sales journey.
_meta._terminal_note: Stage 3 is the final stage of the Anaplan Platform foundational journey — there is no Stage 4 or 5. Real-customer technical work happens in per-application Delivery / Pre-Sales journeys, not here.

name: Credentialized
description: Resource demonstrates platform fluency through three hands-on labs (build a model, design a UX page, build an integration) and earns the Anaplan Platform certification.

tasks.title: Lab 1 — Model Build (lists, hierarchy, modules, formulas)
tasks.description: Hands-on lab in the Stage 2 sandbox: starting from an empty workspace, build a small model that includes 2-3 lists with a parent-child hierarchy, 2 modules with line items and formulas, and a published Page. Tooling verifies structural correctness against the lab spec.
tasks.asset: Lab 1 — Model Build (spec + sandbox + verification tooling)

tasks.title: Lab 2 — UX Page Build (board / worksheet / actions)
tasks.description: Hands-on lab: extend the Lab 1 sandbox model with a Pages-based UX. Build a board page with cards, a worksheet page for data entry, and at least one action button with a process. Tooling verifies the page set against spec.
tasks.asset: Lab 2 — UX Page Build (spec + sandbox + verification tooling)

tasks.title: Lab 3 — Data Hub + Integration
tasks.description: Hands-on lab: build a small data hub, create a model-to-model import from the data hub into the Lab 1 sandbox model, and demonstrate one external integration pattern (file-based or API). Tooling verifies the import structure and run.
tasks.asset: Lab 3 — Data Hub + Integration (spec + sandbox + verification tooling)

tasks.title: Anaplan Platform certification exam
tasks.description: Anaplan-administered certification exam (Anaplan Certified Solutions Associate or equivalent — name TBD pending Op Cmte confirmation). Mix of multiple-choice questions covering all six Stage 2 domains plus a hands-on practical component.

stage_entry_gates.description: Anaplan Platform lab sandbox provisioned and accessible (verifies the Stage 2 provisioning succeeded)

gates.description: Lab 2 (UX Page Build) passed — tooling verification
Lab 3 (Data Hub + Integration) passed — tooling verification
Anaplan Platform certification exam passed — credential issued, foundational prereq satisfied

_estimated_effort_total_note: Three labs (~6-9 hrs total) plus certification exam (~2 hrs).
